body:
## Tackling New Algorithmic Challenges

In **November 2025**, our team **SEU_HOTASHA** took part in the **Monthly Competitive Programming Contest** organized by the Southeast Computer Club (SEUCC) at Southeast University. Each monthly edition brings a fresh problem set, pushing us to refine our analytical thinking, algorithmic efficiency, and team strategies under the pressure of the clock.

## Intense Focus and Problem Solving

Contest sessions demand swift communication, clean implementations, and deep debugging focus. Working closely at our contest workstation, our team dissected algorithmic problems, optimized time and space complexities, and tackled edge cases with pen, paper, and code. The shared intensity of the room created an inspiring environment for every team.

## Strengthening Consistency and Team Chemistry

Consistently participating in monthly contests as **SEU_HOTASHA** has been central to our development as competitive programmers. Beyond the scoreboard, each contest reinforces our resilience, solidifies our problem-solving habits, and prepares us for larger national competitions.

These photographs capture team SEU_HOTASHA in deep concentration at the contest desk, collaborative debugging moments, and team smiles during the November 2025 contest.
